nodes.description: Public constant address of the first vesting beneficiary (0xD2A0...5bF9).
Public constant address of the second vesting beneficiary (0xbAf2...Ac24).
Constant vesting start timestamp 1548086400.
Constant vesting duration in seconds (15638400).
Constant month length in seconds equal to duration/6 (2606400).
ERC20Basic token instance bound to fixed address 0xc9ca...e430 (YCCC).
Accumulated amount of tokens already released to the beneficiaries.
Constructor TokenVesting() with an empty body.
Payable fallback function that rejects value and releases half of the releasable amount to each beneficiary.
releasableAmount(): returns min(vestedAmount - released, current token balance).
vestedAmount(): computes the vested token amount from block.timestamp and the vesting schedule constants.
SafeERC20.safeTransfer: asserts that token.transfer(to, value) succeeds.
SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom: asserts that token.transferFrom(from, to, value) succeeds.
SafeERC20.safeApprove: asserts that token.approve(spender, value) succeeds.
SafeMath.mul: multiplication with overflow assertion.
SafeMath.div: integer division that reverts on division by zero.
SafeMath.sub: subtraction with underflow assertion.
SafeMath.add: addition with overflow assertion.
ERC20Basic.totalSupply interface declaration.
ERC20Basic.balanceOf interface declaration used to read the vesting contract balance.
ERC20Basic.transfer interface declaration invoked by safeTransfer.
ERC20.allowance interface declaration.
ERC20.transferFrom interface declaration invoked by safeTransferFrom.
ERC20.approve interface declaration invoked by safeApprove.
Miner-influenced block timestamp used to drive the vesting schedule computation.
External token transfer to beneficiary1 performed before the final Released event, state updated before the call.
Second external token transfer to beneficiary2 inside the same fallback execution.
Arithmetic state update of the released counter using SafeMath add/mul.
Arithmetic expression inside vestedAmount that scales the total balance by elapsed months.
Local in fallback: result of releasableAmount().
Local in fallback: half of the unreleased amount transferred to each beneficiary.
Local in releasableAmount: vestedAmount() minus released.
Local in releasableAmount: token.balanceOf(this) used as the payout cap.
Local in vestedAmount: token.balanceOf(this).
Local in vestedAmount: current balance plus already released tokens.
Local in vestedAmount: block.timestamp minus start.
Local in vestedAmount: elapsed time rounded down to whole months.

Parameter value (uint256) of SafeERC20.safeTransfer.

Parameter b of SafeMath.mul.
Named return variable c of SafeMath.mul holding the product.
Parameter a of SafeMath.div.
Parameter b of SafeMath.div.

Parameter b of SafeMath.sub.

Parameter b of SafeMath.add.
Named return variable c of SafeMath.add holding the sum.

edges.reason: fallback calls releasableAmount() to obtain the currently claimable amount.
releasableAmount() calls vestedAmount() as the source of the vested total.
unreleased local is assigned the return value of releasableAmount().
unreleasedHalf is derived from unreleased via SafeMath div by 2.
unreleasedHalf.mul(2) is added into the released state counter.
fallback triggers an external token transfer to beneficiary1 while state is being updated.
unreleasedHalf is the value passed to the external safeTransfer call to beneficiary1.
fallback triggers a second external token transfer to beneficiary2 in the same execution.
unreleasedHalf is the value passed to the external safeTransfer call to beneficiary2.
fallback updates released with released.add(unreleasedHalf.mul(2)).
the released state variable is read to compute the new released value.
the result of the add operation is written back into the released state variable.
fallback invokes the SafeERC20.safeTransfer wrapper which performs the external call.
beneficiary1 constant is used as the recipient of the first transfer.
beneficiary2 constant is used as the recipient of the second transfer.
the token state variable is the target contract of the payout transfers.
releasableAmount() subtracts the released counter from the vested amount.
amount local stores vestedAmount().sub(released).
currentBalance local stores token.balanceOf(this).
the amount is compared against the current balance to cap the payout.
releasableAmount() uses SafeMath.sub for the vested minus released subtraction.
vestedAmount() uses SafeMath.sub to compute block.timestamp - start.
releasableAmount() calls the token balanceOf interface to read the contract balance.
vestedAmount() calls the token balanceOf interface to read the contract balance.
releasableAmount() reads the token state variable to query the balance.
vestedAmount() reads the token state variable to query the balance.
vestedAmount() branches on block.timestamp, making payouts miner-timestamp dependent.
timeGap is computed directly from block.timestamp minus start.
vestedAmount() assigns the elapsed time into the timeGap local.
vestedAmount() stores token.balanceOf(this) into its currentBalance local.
vestedAmount() computes totalBalance = currentBalance + released.
vestedAmount() stores the whole-month elapsed time into sec.
vestedAmount() reads the start constant for schedule comparisons.
vestedAmount() reads the duration constant for schedule comparisons and scaling.
vestedAmount() reads the month constant to round the elapsed time.
vestedAmount() calls SafeMath.add for balance plus released and start plus duration.
vestedAmount() calls SafeMath.div for month division and duration scaling.
vestedAmount() calls SafeMath.mul for month rounding and balance scaling.
vestedAmount() executes the totalBalance.mul(sec).div(duration) expression.
totalBalance is the multiplicand of the vesting arithmetic expression.
sec is the month-rounded multiplier of the vesting arithmetic expression.
duration is the divisor applied to the scaled totalBalance.
safeTransfer asserts the result of the external token.transfer call.
safeTransferFrom asserts the result of the external token.transferFrom call.
safeApprove asserts the result of the external token.approve call.
token parameter of safeTransfer flows into the wrapper body.
to parameter of safeTransfer flows into the wrapper body.
value parameter of safeTransfer flows into the wrapper body.
parameter a of SafeMath.mul flows into the multiplication.
parameter b of SafeMath.mul flows into the multiplication.
SafeMath.mul assigns the product to the named return variable c before asserting overflow.
parameter a of SafeMath.div flows into the division.
parameter b of SafeMath.div flows into the division.
parameter a of SafeMath.sub flows into the subtraction.
parameter b of SafeMath.sub flows into the subtraction.
parameter a of SafeMath.add flows into the addition.
parameter b of SafeMath.add flows into the addition.
SafeMath.add assigns the sum to the named return variable c before asserting overflow.

normalization_plan.reason: unreleased is a transient local inside the fallback used only to derive unreleasedHalf.
unreleasedHalf is the payout amount consumed by the external safeTransfer call.
amount is an internal temporary of releasableAmount with no independent state.
currentBalance is a read-only temporary of releasableAmount used for the cap comparison.
currentBalance is a read-only temporary of vestedAmount used to build totalBalance.
totalBalance feeds directly into the vesting arithmetic expression.
timeGap is a schedule temporary of vestedAmount derived from block.timestamp.
sec is the month-rounded factor used in the vesting arithmetic expression.
token parameter is bound into the SafeERC20.safeTransfer wrapper body.
to parameter is bound into the SafeERC20.safeTransfer wrapper body.
value parameter is bound into the SafeERC20.safeTransfer wrapper body.
parameter a is consumed only by SafeMath.mul.
parameter b is consumed only by SafeMath.mul.
named return variable c exists only within SafeMath.mul.
parameter a is consumed only by SafeMath.div.
parameter b is consumed only by SafeMath.div.
parameter a is consumed only by SafeMath.sub.
parameter b is consumed only by SafeMath.sub.
parameter a is consumed only by SafeMath.add.
parameter b is consumed only by SafeMath.add.
named return variable c exists only within SafeMath.add.
